blocks.text: `internal/agentbridge/runtimeactor` is the mailbox actor that owns one RuntimeID's provider execution capacity. One actor goroutine owns the in-flight task map and slot state.

items: Run adapter `Detect` during start and reconcile the raw daemon observation into public C3 `ProviderCapability`.
Include `PolicyBundleVersion` and detected executable fingerprint in the capability fingerprint input.
Fail closed for max-concurrent slot exhaustion, duplicate task id, unavailable provider, and unknown provider.
Submit tasks to `session.Start` and attach an optional `ProtocolDriverProvider` to the session.
Cascade `Cancel` and `Stop` through session cancellation, process kill, and slot release.
Project `Status` and `HeartbeatPayload` for local settings UI and control-plane heartbeat consumers.

An inconclusive authentication/probe refresh must preserve the last observed executable/capability identity for running sessions; it reports unknown health and retries after the existing TTL. A confirmed executable/version change still blocks pinned runs.
Capability refresh on Submit must fence existing sessions against a confirmed executable/version change just like Status refresh; changing the cached capability cannot erase a running session pin.
Supervisor polling, task claim, and runtime selection.
EventIngestor append and task transition decisions.
Workdir preparation and native config injection.
Task DB, project, MWSD, local API, SaaS transport, or infra persistence.
